results.title: Get started with Perplexity teammates - Perplexity Help Center
results.description: Enterprise Pro and Enterprise Max are not included by default in this launch. Teammates build on the capabilities of Perplexity Computer, including Connectors, files, and code; see What is Computer? for an introduction. They add capabilities for ongoing work and large projects: Multi-agent orchestration: A teammate breaks a goal into tasks, runs them in parallel across multiple agents, and adds agents as the work grows.

results.title: Perplexity Teammates | Agents Designed for Work
results.description: Give a teammate a responsibility, such as managing a growth campaign, triaging incoming bug reports, tracking your metrics, or researching a new market, and it owns that work around the clock. It plans the tasks, brings in more agents when the work grows, and follows through until the result is ready for your review. ... Teammates are available today for Perplexity Max subscribers, on the web.
